name: Copy File
description: Copy a file or directory between configured filesystem roots. Endpoints may be relative paths plus root/toRoot, or file://<root>/<path> references. The destination must not exist and its parent must exist. Dispatches directly through Java NIO without routing bytes through the caller; cross-provider atomicity and efficiency are provider-dependent. Directory copies use standard shallow-copy semantics. The destination root must be writable; the source may be read-only.
creator: Covia

root.description: Source root and default destination root; optional when from is a file:// reference

toRoot.description: Optional destination root override; a qualified to reference may name it instead

from.description: Existing relative source path or file://<root>/<path> reference

to.description: New relative destination path or file://<root>/<path> reference
